about: KhaytOrderMoney.addedPartMark(order): whether a part added BY HAND to an existing job carries orderLevelCosts (costed without labour and packaging, which the order carries once). Turki, Nov 19: a hand-added part gets its OWN labour, so false for every order while HAND_PARTS_SHARE_ONCE is false. `flipped` is what each case gives with the switch set to true. The desktop (renderer/job-sheet.js, renderer/build.js) and the Mac (partsForSave) call this one function.

cases.why: a job from a product with labour and packaging once
components and overhead are NOT once-costs of a product
zero or negative once-costs are none
the calculator's cart state (currentFixedCosts) is read the same way
